name: Writers Blocks
pitch: A workspace for books: map the structure, give every piece a direction, and rearrange freely as you draft.
problem: One long document hides a book's shape until it's too late.

stats.label: stages: gather, plan, draft, revise, share
views of one book, from Map to Read

features.title: Map the whole book
features.text: Parts, chapters and sections as a tree you restructure by dragging.
details: Sideways or top-down, with status and word count on every card
Fold branches, zoom, and fit the book to the screen
Split, merge and move blocks, and undo any change

screen.alt: The Map view of a sample novel, The Salt Year: parts branching into chapters and sections, each card with a word count

features.title: Every piece has a purpose
features.text: Each block says what happens and why it's here, so you write toward something.
details: Read down the Outline to check the story holds together
Status from idea to done, word targets and margin notes
Write view shows the blocks just before and after

screen.alt: The Outline view: a table of blocks with What happens, Why it's here, status and word count

features.title: Brainstorm and keep it
features.text: Ideas go on a canvas like sticky notes, grouped, linked and tied to a block.
details: Deal a prompt, freewrite on a timer, or collide two ideas
Drag an idea onto the outline and it becomes a block

screen.alt: The Notebook canvas: sticky notes grouped under The ledger and Salt as metaphor, linked with dotted lines

features.title: Your file, your editor
features.text: Projects live in a file on your computer, and the app works offline.
details: Optional AI editor asks and suggests; it doesn't draft for you
Autosaves to that file in Chrome, Edge, Arc and Brave
Export to PDF, Word, Markdown or a single web page

screens.alt: Writers Blocks' Desk for The Salt Year: the premise, a suggested next step, and progress through the five stages
screens.caption: The Desk suggests what to work on next
